title: Broadcast Exchange Format (BXF) — Requirements and Informative Notes
scope: The Broadcast eXchange Format (BXF) defines the format and content of XML Messages for the interchange of data and metadata among professional systems.

outline.title: All text entered as strings and all XML messages themselves shall conform to UTF-8 as the standard for encoding all characters, per ISO/IEC 10646:2017 Information technology – Universal Coded Character Set (UCS).
The BXF schema is included as part of the ST2021-4-2018 Broadcast Exchange Format (BXF) Schema Documentation package.

The BXF schema supports request/response transactions and asynchronous notifications. The transaction type is communicated in the message itself, by means of the message type field attribute of BxfMessage - the root structure in the XML message.
